name: Eikonal Wavefronts
desc: The eikonal equation solved by fast sweeping: first-arrival wavefronts race outward from drifting seeds through a heterogeneous medium, refracting around slow lenses, racing down fast channels, folding into caustic cusps and colliding into shock seams where two fronts meet — arrival-time isochrones ripple perpetually outward as false-colour travel-time tomography, blazing caustics, a muted bathymetric chart, dense interference fringes, or ironbow thermal.

energy.doc: brightness + colour gain of the domains, arrival bands and caustic folds

scale.doc: magnification into a sub-region of the survey — guaranteed visible change

speed.doc: medium drift + the rate the isochrone bands march outward (0.2 still propagates)

density.doc: number of wave sources, 2 to 9 — more sources, more shock seams carving the frame

hetero.doc: heterogeneity of the medium: 0 = uniform speed (fronts stay circular, seams go straight), 1 = violent slow lenses and fast channels that bend every front

bands.doc: isochrone count and contrast — from a few broad terraces to dense fine wavefront rings

hue.doc: primary hue; each source is offset around the ramp from it

x.doc: horizontal pan of the magnified region

y.doc: vertical pan of the magnified region

style.doc: aesthetic: false-colour travel-time tomography / blazing caustic folds on a dark medium / muted bathymetric terraces / dense fringes only / ironbow thermal

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the medium and the source orbits
